name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic)
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V6 (Magnetic) brings the AoLong line's refined speedsolving feel to its most accessible build yet, pairing a lightweight carbon fiber core with a 48-magnet layout and full dual 8-level tuning. It's a spring-tensioned magnetic speed cube that gives you deep adjustability and solid control without stepping up to the MagLev or ball-core tiers.
features: Accessible entry to the AoLong V6 line: Get the V6's engineered feel and full tuning range in its lightest, most affordable spring-tensioned build.
48-magnet control: A magnetic layout that clicks pieces into place for faster, more accurate turning.
Tune it to your hands: Dual 8-level adjustment unlocks 64 feel configurations, so you can dial in exactly the control you want.
Stickerless and ready to go: Half-bright stickerless shades that stay vivid with nothing to peel.
8-level spring elasticity: Mechanical spring adjustment with distinct, precise steps.
8-level tension: Fine-tune the balance between looseness and tightness, pairing high corner-cutting with high precision.
